name: Smoked Mackerel
desc: Landed at Killybegs, Ireland's biggest fishing port, and smoked over oak until it's gold. Restores 110 HP. Your bag will smell of it for a week.

name: Carrageen Pudding
desc: Carrageen moss is a seaweed off the west coast. Boiled in milk it sets into a wobbly pudding that grannies swear cures everything. Cures every status.

name: Donegal Tweed Cap
desc: Hand-woven Donegal tweed, flecked like a hillside of heather and gorse. Keeps out the Atlantic wind and gives everyone the look of a man who owns a field.
msg: {name}'s Tweed Cap kept the wind off!

name: Errigal Quartz
desc: A chip of pale quartzite from the top of Errigal, faintly pink. The mountain glows this colour at sunset.

name: Tory Clay
desc: A twist of clay from Tory Island. Tradition says St Colmcille blessed it, and no rat can abide it, which is why Tory has none.
msg: {name}'s Tory Clay kept the vermin off!

name: Crotal
desc: Grey crusty lichen scraped from the rocks. Boiled with wool it gives the warm rust browns of Donegal tweed, and a smell like a wet dog.

name: Whin Blossom
desc: Gorse flowers, which smell of coconut on a warm day. They dye wool a yellow you could see from Tory.
